description: A Cachet Vantage 900 in apartment trim — matte graphite, floor to ceiling, filling the alcove where a walk-in closet would go. Suits hang behind a hairline of warm light, each on its own motorised rail, and the facade is machined so precisely that no join shows anywhere on it. Cachet's marketing calls it a discretion suite. Cachet's marketing does not say what for.
name: Cachet Vantage 900 wardrobe
